meta.title: Leadership Style Diagnosis
meta.description: Discover your unique leadership style and learn how to become an effective leader.

hero.title: Discovering Your Leadership DNA
hero.description: Understand your natural leadership tendencies and learn how to adapt to different situations.

options.text: Present a clear vision and inspire the team
Brainstorm together and gather team input
Identify each member's strengths and provide 1:1 coaching
Develop overall strategy and set clear direction

q1.text: When your team is given a new project, how do you get started?

options.text: Ask how you can help and provide needed support
Analyze the problem together and find solutions
Present clear solution and action plan
Help them grow by asking questions to solve it themselves

q2.text: When a team member is in trouble, what is your first reaction?

options.text: Listen to team opinions and decide together
Judge from long-term goals and strategic perspective
Decide quickly and give clear instructions
Check if it aligns with vision and decide

q3.text: When making important decisions, what do you usually do?

options.text: Motivate team members and lead change
Create coaching plan for individual development
Analyze causes together and find improvements
Reestablish clear standards and responsibilities

q4.text: How do you respond when your team is not performing well?

options.text: Helping team members grow and develop
Presenting clear vision and painting the future
Supporting team members and helping their success
Developing strategy to achieve organizational goals

q5.text: What role of a leader do you consider most important?

options.text: Facilitate so everyone can share opinions
Remind of big picture and long-term goals
Run efficiently and draw clear conclusions
Connect team ideas and create synergy

q6.text: What is your main role in team meetings?

options.text: Share team vision and values we pursue
Ask what they need and help them adjust
Have 1:1 time to understand strengths and goals
Explain clear role and expectations

q7.text: When new team members join, how do you welcome them?

options.text: Encourage free idea sharing and experimentation
Present innovative vision and inspire
Help team members collaborate and create synergy
Coach to develop individual creative strengths

q8.text: What do you do to increase creativity in your team?

options.text: Listen to both sides and find solution together
Decide based on clear principles and standards
Resolve conflict by reminding of bigger goals
Help understand perspectives and use as growth opportunity

q9.text: How do you deal with conflict situations?

options.text: A team where each member performs at their best
A team that continuously innovates and leads change
A team that effectively achieves strategic goals
A team that collaborates and creates synergy

q10.text: How do you want to develop your team in the long term?

strengths: Providing strong motivation and inspiration to team members
Encouraging innovative ideas and creative thinking
Helping teams reach their full potential
challenges: Tendency to focus on vision over detailed execution
bestEnvironment: Projects where long-term vision is important
Environment prioritizing team development and growth
developmentTips: Balance short-term goals with long-term vision
transformational.title: transformational leader
transformational.subtitle: A leader who leads change through inspiration and innovation
transformational.description: You are a transformational leader who inspires and motivates your team and pursues continuous innovation and change. Present a vision and lead team members toward a better future.
transformational.coreApproach: Organizational change through inspiration, motivation and innovation
transformational.communicationStyle: Emotional communication through inspiring storytelling and shared vision
transformational.decisionMaking: Decision-making with innovation and long-term impact
transformational.teamManagement: Pursuing personal growth and team change simultaneously

developmentTips: Prepare for situations requiring quick decisions
Recognize need for leadership at times
democratic.title: democratic leader
democratic.subtitle: Leader who makes the best decisions through participation and consensus
democratic.description: You are a democratic leader who respects the opinions of your team members and encourages participation. Leverage the team's collective intelligence through collaborative decision-making and ensure everyone has a sense of ownership.
democratic.coreApproach: Decision-making through participation, consensus, and cooperation
democratic.decisionMaking: Collect opinions from team members and reach consensus
democratic.teamManagement: Autonomous team operation through participation and cooperation

challenges: Focus on long-term development over short-term results
Difficulty providing equal attention to all team members
Direct instruction may be needed at times
bestEnvironment: Organizations where talent development is important
developmentTips: Balance team goals with individual development
coaching.title: Coaching type leader
coaching.subtitle: Mentor-type leader who supports growth and development
coaching.description: You are a coaching leader who cares deeply about the growth and development of each team member. We value 1:1 relationships and help each person discover their strengths and develop their capabilities.
coaching.communicationStyle: Reflective dialogue through listening and questioning
coaching.decisionMaking: Consider growth and learning opportunities for team members
coaching.teamManagement: Establish and implement a personalized development plan

strengths: Giving team members sense of purpose
challenges: Possible lack of attention to current problems
developmentTips: Develop execution plans and detailed strategies
Listen to team members' realistic concerns
visionary.title: an unconventional leader
visionary.subtitle: A leader who envisions the future and presents direction
visionary.description: You are a visionary leader who provides a clear vision and leads your team into the future. Sees the big picture, sets strategic direction, and inspires team members to move toward their goals.
visionary.coreApproach: Presenting a clear vision and setting strategic direction
visionary.decisionMaking: Based on long-term vision and strategic goals
visionary.teamManagement: Team integration through shared vision and goal alignment

strengths: Emphasis on team welfare and satisfaction
challenges: Balancing team needs with organizational goals
developmentTips: Balance organizational goals with team welfare
servant.title: servant leader
servant.subtitle: A leader who serves team members and helps them succeed
servant.description: You are a servant leader who supports your team and puts their success first. We create an environment where team members can do their best with an attitude of service rather than authority.
servant.coreApproach: Leadership through team member support and service
servant.communicationStyle: Warm communication centered on listening and empathy
servant.decisionMaking: Putting the needs and well-being of team members first
servant.teamManagement: Developing autonomous teams through support and empowerment

challenges: Possible lack of flexibility to change
Tendency to prioritize process over people
Execution delay due to excessive analysis
strategic.title: strategic leader
strategic.subtitle: A leader who achieves goals through systematic analysis and planning
strategic.description: You are a strategic leader who creates and executes strategies based on data and analysis. Set long-term goals and achieve results effectively through systematic planning.
strategic.coreApproach: Data-based strategy establishment and systematic execution
strategic.decisionMaking: Based on data analysis and strategic goals
strategic.teamManagement: Systematic management through KPI and performance indicators

collaborative.title: cooperative leader
collaborative.subtitle: A leader who creates results through teamwork and synergy
collaborative.description: You are a cooperative leader who maximizes cooperation and synergy among team members. We achieve greater results by connecting each individual’s strengths and creating a culture of working together.
collaborative.coreApproach: Creating synergy through teamwork and collaboration
collaborative.decisionMaking: Emphasis on the team's collective intelligence and consensus
collaborative.teamManagement: Team management through cooperation and interdependence

bestEnvironment: Projects where quick execution is important
authoritative.title: authoritative leader
authoritative.subtitle: A leader who drives performance with clear instructions and standards
authoritative.description: You are an authoritative leader who leads your team through clear standards and instructions. We value efficiency and performance, and achieve our goals through quick decision-making and execution.
authoritative.coreApproach: Efficient goal achievement through clear direction and control
authoritative.communicationStyle: Clear and direct instructions and feedback
authoritative.teamManagement: Establish clear roles, responsibilities, and performance standards
